locations.note: Horizon Japan's city: a stylised Tokyo of downtown streets, docklands and suburbs, with the festival's neon stage among them.
The scramble crossing, recreated as the heart of the city's street races.
Tokyo Tower stands over the map's downtown.
The 300-metre avenue of ginkgo trees, golden in the map's autumn.
The elevated C1 Loop, the 14.8-kilometre expressway ring, is the map's highway circuit.
Mount Fuji rises over the map's mountain region.
The Japanese Alps give the map its high passes and snow.
The hairpins of Mount Haruna, the touge road of Initial D.
The Bandai-Azuma Skyline, 29 kilometres of volcanic mountain road, recreated in the north of the map.
